VO_01_INTRO.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_01_INTRO.subtitle_id: Unit Gagak-03, OCC Bekasi online. Sudirman blackout total. Hidupkan generator stasiun, bersihkan gerbang tiket!
VO_01_INTRO.subtitle_en: Gagak-03, OCC Bekasi is online. Total Sudirman blackout. Power the station generator and clear the faregates!

VO_02_GEN_ON.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_02_GEN_ON.subtitle_id: Daya cadangan aktif! Lampu peron menyala. Awas, suara mesin memancing infected dari jalan raya!
VO_02_GEN_ON.subtitle_en: Aux power active! Platform lights on. Caution: engine noise is drawing infected from the boulevard!

VO_03_STREET_HINT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_03_STREET_HINT.subtitle_id: Trotoar luar penuh perbekalan. Cek gerobak kopi dan kotak PLN jalanan sebelum kamu naik ke peron.
VO_03_STREET_HINT.subtitle_en: Outer sidewalks have supplies. Check the coffee carts and street PLN boxes before heading up to the platform.

VO_04_CALL_HOLD.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_04_CALL_HOLD.subtitle_id: Rangkaian LRT darurat meluncur dari stabling. Bertahan di peron empat puluh lima detik!
VO_04_CALL_HOLD.subtitle_en: Emergency LRT consist en route from stabling. Hold the platform for forty-five seconds!

VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.subtitle_id: Stasiun Dukuh Atas BSI. Kereta evakuasi telah tiba di peron satu. Hati-hati celah peron.
VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.subtitle_en: Dukuh Atas BSI Station. Evacuation train has arrived on Platform 1. Mind the platform gap.

VO_06_BOARD_WARN.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_06_BOARD_WARN.subtitle_id: Kereta sudah merapat! Masuk ke kabin sekarang sebelum kawanan infected menjebol pintu kaca!
VO_06_BOARD_WARN.subtitle_en: Train has docked! Get into the cabin now before the swarm breaches the window glass!

VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.subtitle_id: Cawang Interchange. Jalur terkunci sinyal mati. Ambil sekring bypass dari kabin bangkai kereta di Jalur Empat!
VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.subtitle_en: Cawang Interchange. Tracks locked by dead signals. Retrieve the bypass fuse from the derelict cab on Track 4!

VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.speaker: PLAYER_G2
VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.subtitle_id: Sekring bypass didapat! Membawa shotgun taktis dari bangkai masinis. Bergerak kembali ke Peron Satu.
VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.subtitle_en: Bypass fuse secured! Salvaged a tactical shotgun from the driver's wreck. Moving back to Platform 1.

VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.subtitle_id: Awas hazmat infected di skybridge! Dia melontarkan cairan asam beracun dari jarak jauh, cari perlindungan!
VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.subtitle_en: Watch out for the hazmat infected on the skybridge! Lobbing toxic acid from range—get behind cover!

VO_10_HARJA_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_10_HARJA_ARR.subtitle_id: Harjamukti gelap gulita! Gunakan senter. Riset vaksin Dr. Rina ada di Kebun Atap Selatan!
VO_10_HARJA_ARR.subtitle_en: Harjamukti is pitch black! Use your flashlight. Dr. Rina's vaccine research is on the South Roof Garden!

VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.subtitle_id: Brute lapis baja huru-hara di depan! Tembak kepalanya atau pancing ke drum merah yang meledak!
VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.subtitle_en: Riot-armored Brute ahead! Aim for the head or lure him into the red explosive drums!

VO_12_VAX_FOUND.speaker: PLAYER_G2
VO_12_VAX_FOUND.subtitle_id: Vaksin spora Dr. Rina berhasil diamankan. Menuju hanggar depo untuk membuka jalur traksi utama.
VO_12_VAX_FOUND.subtitle_en: Dr. Rina's spore vaccine secured. Heading to the depot hanger to unlock the main traction line.

VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.subtitle_id: Screamer terdeteksi! Tembak kista lehernya sebelum dia menjerit memanggil seluruh infected di depo!
VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.subtitle_en: Screamer detected! Shoot the neck cyst before she shrieks and summons the entire depot horde!

VO_14_HORN_HINT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_14_HORN_HINT.subtitle_id: Gunakan tombol klakson di kabin! Frekuensi suara LRT memecah konsentrasi spora dan memancing kawanan itu!
VO_14_HORN_HINT.subtitle_en: Use the horn switch in the cab! The LRT acoustic frequency disrupts spore focus and lures the horde!

VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.subtitle_id: Amunisi menipis? Gunakan konsol Peron Dua untuk mundur ke stasiun sebelumnya dan mengisi ulang logistik!
VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.subtitle_en: Running low on ammo? Use the Platform 2 console to backtrack to prior stations and restock!

VO_16_KUNING_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_16_KUNING_ARR.subtitle_id: Ngarai Rasuna Said dilanda badai muson. Hati-hati terpeleset di peron, jalanan bawah banjir parah!
VO_16_KUNING_ARR.subtitle_en: The Rasuna Said canyon is hit by the monsoon storm. Mind your footing—the street below is severely flooded!

VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.subtitle_id: Stasiun Cikoko. Tangga transfer KRL Cawang penuh reruntuhan. Bersihkan barikade jalan tol untuk melanjutkan!
VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.subtitle_en: Cikoko Station. KRL Cawang transfer stairs are choked with debris. Clear the highway roadblock to push through!

VO_18_SETIA_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_18_SETIA_ARR.subtitle_id: Setiabudi! Garis pertahanan terakhir Kodam Jaya. Hubungkan tiga relai sinyal untuk membuka gerbang evakuasi!
VO_18_SETIA_ARR.subtitle_en: Setiabudi! Kodam Jaya's final defense line. Connect all three signal relays to open the extraction gate!

VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.subtitle_id: Gelombang merah datang dari segala arah! Bertahan sembilan puluh detik, helikopter evakuasi sudah di atas gedung!
VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.subtitle_en: Red moon swarm incoming from all directions! Hold for ninety seconds—extraction chopper is over the rooftop!

VO_20_COUNT_10.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_20_COUNT_10.subtitle_id: Sepuluh detik lagi! Masuk ke kabin masinis, bersiap tabrak barikade terakhir!
VO_20_COUNT_10.subtitle_en: Ten seconds remaining! Get into the driver's cab and prepare to ram through the final barrier!

VO_21_VICTORY.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_21_VICTORY.subtitle_id: Pintu gerbang terbuka! Jalur aman terkonfirmasi. Kamu berhasil, Arya. Vaksin dan data koridor selamat!
VO_21_VICTORY.subtitle_en: Blast doors open! Clear line confirmed. You made it, Arya. The vaccine and corridor data are safe!

VO_22_GAME_OVER.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_22_GAME_OVER.subtitle_id: Gagak-03 tumbang! Telemetri vital hilang... Seluruh unit, koridor CB/BK dinyatakan gugur.
VO_22_GAME_OVER.subtitle_en: Gagak-03 is down! Vital telemetry lost... All units, corridor CB/BK is officially lost.

VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.subtitle_id: LRT Jabodebek mengutamakan keselamatan. Tetap berada di belakang garis kuning demi keselamatan Anda.
VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.subtitle_en: LRT Jabodebek prioritizes safety. Please stand behind the yellow line for your personal safety.

VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.subtitle_id: Pintu kereta akan ditutup. Mohon tidak memaksakan diri untuk masuk. Mind the closing doors.
VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.subtitle_en: Train doors are closing. Please do not force entry. Mind the closing doors.
